subject: Web Development
title: Adaptive and Personalized Experiences
description: A quick, practical guide to Adaptive and Personalized Experiences.

hook.text: Two visitors land on the same URL but see entirely different content tailored to them.

buildup.text: AI analyzes behavior, preferences, and context to customize every page in real time.

discovery.text: Netflix shows different thumbnails for the same movie depending on your viewing history.

twist.text: Personalization can create filter bubbles — you only see what algorithms think you want.

climax.text: The future web must balance personalization with discovery, relevance with serendipity.

punchline.text: Personalization should expand your world, not shrink it.
